As per the above findings of the Hon‟ble Supreme Court, the moment generation and sale takes place in more than one State, the Central Commission becomes the Appropriate Commission under the Act. Therefore, combined reading of Section 79(1) and Section 63 of the Act and the decision of Hon‟ble Supreme Court in Energy Watchdog Judgment makes it clear that this Commission has the jurisdiction to proceed with the adoption of tariff in the present case under Section 63 of the Act.
